DIAGNOSIS READY: Cradle Cap (Infantile Seborrheic Dermatitis)

The clinical picture of greasy yellow scales on the scalp and forehead in a 3-month-old, worsening in cold weather and with a family history of psoriasis, is classic for seborrheic dermatitis, not tuberculosis. The skin biopsy I requested will help confirm this by ruling out psoriasis or other inflammatory conditions.
